messages:
AJ: Heads-up, customer asked in their SQ for a contiguous 7-day export with token-redaction proof and KMS rotation evidence. Can we deliver on Hosted?
Maria: short answer: yes, with caveats. Hosted default is sampled at high QPS. We can run a bounded full-capture job for a window and produce a signed export, or provide a sampled export plus deterministic sampling proofs.
Devon: technical flow we use: 1) query request_ids for timeframe, 2) fetch payload blobs from object store, 3) rehydrate tokens where retained, 4) apply PII redaction rules v3, 5) sign each record with our audit private key.
AJ: customer wants explicit proof no plaintext keys left HSM, plus rotation timeline.
Maria: we provide HSM audit events (Sign/Unwrap) and CMK metadata snapshots. We cannot show plaintext keys — but we can export envelope headers (key IDs + wrapped metadata) and a signed statement of custody.
Devon: hosted uses our internal envelope scheme: per-tenant ephemeral envelope keys wrapped by our CMK. For Dedicated/private BYO-KEK is different. I'll note that in the reply.
AJ: they reported seeing gaps in logs and worry auth events were dropped. quick explanation?
Maria: sampling is deterministic per-tenant+hour when throughput crosses threshold; anomalies (error codes, latency spikes, sec alerts) trigger adaptive capture, so important events are kept. We can run a deterministic lookup for a given request_id to show whether it was sampled.
Devon: if they require guaranteed no-gaps, recommend Dedicated or a temporary elevated-capture window on Hosted (we can flip capture to 100% for requested window and sign the export).
AJ: deliverables requested: 1) short legal-friendly summary of what we can provide, 2) ops runbook (steps + artifacts), 3) sample signed sanitized export, 4) timeline for KMS/HSM proofs.
Maria: I'll draft the one-pager + runbook. Include the exact CLI we use and the redaction ruleset.
Devon: I'll generate a sanitized sample export tomorrow. Pulling formal HSM audit logs from provider requires 48-72h turnaround to get signed outputs.
sec-bot: ACK — will attach audit-key cert chain and current fingerprint to any export artifacts.
AJ: good. I'll reply to customer with scope and timelines and offer a short call to review artifacts. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maria: also adding appendix comparing Hosted vs Dedicated capture guarantees and what evidence each provides.
Devon: creating ops ticket for temporary elevated capture in case they want to toggle during the window. Ping me to schedule.
AJ: closing loop, i'll send the initial customer reply and schedule the follow-up call.
